The '''Teh'Jar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teh'Jar II]].
